title: Auto-assign designers
subtitle: After tool check is done (result other than OK), orders are automatically distributed to designers by priority chain: customer → product → factory.

priority1.title: Priority 1 — Customer → Designer
priority1.subtitle: Drag customers into a designer's column — saved instantly on drop. Orders from an assigned customer always go to that designer, regardless of factory.

priority2.title: Priority 2 — Product → Designer
priority2.subtitle: Drag products into a designer's column — saved instantly on drop. Orders that don't match a customer but match a product go to that designer, regardless of factory.

priority3.title: Priority 3 — By factory
priority3.subtitle: Remaining orders are distributed to the factory's designers by weight, auto-balanced by each designer's current open-order count. Each designer belongs to only 1 factory.
